Colour key

The colour of a name on the map is the grade of its record. It says how well the record is sourced, not a verdict on the space.

  • Cleanneeds at least one source outside the space’s own website.
  • Flaggedneeds a recorded reason, such as a flagged funder or a protest over its funding.
  • Unverifiedis every other space: its record cites no source outside the space’s own website yet.

A city takes the colour most of its spaces have. Open a space to read its record and the sources behind its grade.

How the records work

Funding grades run from A to F.

  • Grade Athe record shows how much money came in, and no funder is flagged.
  • Grade Bfunders are named without amounts, and none is flagged.
  • Grade Cno funder is flagged, but a tie or complaint is on record, such as a protest or a sponsor who left.
  • Grade Done funder is flagged, such as an oil, tobacco, gambling or arms company.
  • Grade Ftwo or more funders are flagged, or one flagged funder and a complaint on record.
